canonical_statement: Every closed, connected, orientable three-manifold admits the canonical decomposition and locally homogeneous geometric pieces asserted by Thurston's geometrization conjecture; in particular, every closed simply connected three-manifold is homeomorphic to the three-sphere.
domain_and_universes: A prospective Lean target quantifies over a topological or smooth 3-manifold type M in an explicit universe; the exact mathlib object model and universe remain to be frozen.

for the Poincare corollary, M is additionally simply connected
hypotheses: simple connectivity only for the Poincare corollary
conclusion: Geometrization for M; consequently, under simple connectivity, M is homeomorphic to S^3.
